messages:
Elliot (People Ops): Hey team - married overseas last week and want to add spouse. We have the foreign marriage certificate (not translated yet) and spouse only has a passport, no SSN/ITIN yet. Can I add dental/vision now and medical later when SSN is available? Also worried about HSA contribution impact.
Priya B.: Congrats! Marriage counts as a QLE, so you have 30 days to submit docs for midyear changes. Dental/vision carriers are usually more lenient with IDs; medical carriers often want SSN/ITIN but can accept a pending-ssn workflow in many cases.
Samir (Benefits): To add dental/vision now, we typically need: copy of marriage cert (even untranslated), spouse passport, and a note saying "dental only" in the submission. For medical without SSN, we can file "SSN pending" with passport + marriage cert + a signed attestation that SSN will be provided when issued. Carriers differ on acceptance.
Elliot (People Ops): If I do dental now and medical later, will payroll pro-rate? When does HSA switch to family limit?
PayrollBot: Mid-period additions are prorated. Premium deductions start after carrier confirms effective date. HSA family limits take effect on the calendar date your family medical coverage becomes effective; payroll can update contributions once effective date is confirmed.
Priya B.: Action items: 1) Upload passport + marriage cert to the secure HR upload link (internal only) and mark "QLE - Add spouse (dental only)" if you want dental immediately. 2) If you prefer to submit medical now as SSN pending, include an attestation and we'll submit to the carrier and let you know if they require ITIN/SSN later. 3) If you use PretendCo's translator, please attach the translation; if not, we'll send carrier the untranslated cert and note translation incoming.
Elliot (People Ops): What's the secure upload URL? Don't want to email scans.
Samir (Benefits): Use https://hr.redwood.com/secure-upload (internal). If you email benefits@redwood.com we will reply with a transient upload link; do not paste docs in Slack.
Elliot (People Ops): Thanks. One more: spouse will be on my immigration paperwork — could that cause delays with carrier?
Samir (Benefits): Sometimes carriers ask for additional proof of residency or joint accounts if they need to validate relationship. If they request extra docs we'll notify you. Typical carrier turnaround is ~7-14 business days after complete submission.
Elliot (People Ops): Great, uploading now. Appreciate the help! :heart:
